notes.title: Controller support is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633782/20d7bfc98461095624f2dacd9056f24dc64ff434.png[/img]

It's finally here!

Added the long awaited controller support, so we can now enjoy the game fully. Got to be honest, didn't think a controller will make such a big difference in the gameplay until I tested it.

The version is still undergoing various tests so feel free to send us your feedback.

notes.title: Update V0.70
notes.content:
Hello there! 
Yes we know we haven't posted any new updates in a while but please rest assured, we are working hard to get the game out as soon as possible. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633782/aab2adc7b2561be6176406fcf028a469e53f15d1.png[/img]
V0.70 is now live and we hope you'll find the changes enjoyable, some of the changes amongst other small bugs that we fixed are:
* added a more visual feedback for the player at the end of each completed level
*added new crystal type
*added a stronger visual effect for some of the power ups(the ones that don't have are going to be updated in a future update)
*added a small intro for the level 2 mini-boss
*visual feedback and warning on time mechanic
*added enemy portals

Thank you for all your support and feedback and have a great weekend everyone!

notes.title: Demo update to v0.67
notes.content:
This update includes bug fixes and a few visual changes based on your feedback. The main focus was replacing the text feedback with graphics and visual effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633782/2a6fff0eec880cbfc3df8b4caf5b53c60837b2a5.png[/img]
*old hexagons are now replaced by crystals
*enemies/crystals destroyed no longer show the value gained in text form
*damage dealt text size is reduced 
*when player gets hit he drops some of the crystals on the ground
*additional sound effects added for crystals destroyed/collected
*crystal collection time is greatly reduced making it easier to collect even in mid-air
*crystals get destroyed with one hit
*Some UI information panels re-positioned to make the read easier during gameplay

Thank you again , to all of you that sent the feedback and hope the changes will make the game experience better.

notes.title: Update v 0.62
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.61 is now live![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633782/2fb157e9db07e159343adc05622653807185ebd4.png[/img]
We're still working to make the game better but don't want to let the demo fall to far behind either, so a new update is live. 
What changed?
[b]*Increased bullet accuracy[/b]
Some of you complaint about the bullets accuracy, so we listened and optimized it.

[b]*Reduced shield duration, enhanced the effect and increased the count from 2 to 6[/b]
As you know, at the start of each level you had 2 shields that would offer you protection for 30s each. The duration was too long, so it was reduced to 10 seconds (will be able to increase the duration with power ups in a future update), but you now have 6 shields each level. The score bonus for unused shields remains the same. 

[b]*Fixed platform trigger bugs[/b]
With the last update a bug was introduced that caused the platform triggers to be ignored if the player was on top of it. Fixed!

[b]*Reduced some enemies hit points and fire rate[/b]
Some enemies had way too many hit points and the fight got boring pretty quick while others had a high fire rate that caused players to avoid them too often.

[b]*Added smoke zone[/b]
Besides challenge stages, a smoke zone was implemented too.

[b]*Added Camera Distance setting[/b]
You can now adjust the camera distance. Wanted to give you a choice at least, at this time you can only have Far and Close Camera. This is a fixed position that you can access from the settings menu at your disposal at any time. You also have the dynamic zoom during gameplay (holding up arrow)

We feel these changes make both the game and your experience better. Thank you for your feedback and suggestions!

*Reduced some enemies hit points and fire rate

notes.title: Small update with bug fix after feedback from players
notes.content:
[b][h1]Bugs are a pain for every developer[/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633782/152edf1dbdde31068f55333abe82ea4feb8d83e0.png[/img]
Updated the Demo with a small bug fix that was causing the levels to be double loaded. 
Please, all of you players out there that test any game, give the developer your feedback, no matter how short or insignificant seems to you, it can actually make a huge difference for the game. I received feedback from a player who played the Demo and he stated that he enjoyed the game, but at the end he said - he double boss and was kind enough to take even a screenshot. 
It was a huge help because, based on his feedback I was able to reproduce the bug and take action to fix it quite fast. The scenes should now load properly and have a better gameplay experience due to that one feedback.

Stay tuned for another update at the end of next week!
